title: Confined cursor workers sign in on a host with no desktop keyring
description: With a stub cursor-agent that reads its sign-in the way the real one does on a keyring-less host ($XDG_CONFIG_HOME/cursor/auth.json, falling back to $HOME/.config, never CURSOR_CONFIG_DIR), under real bubblewrap: a confined worker launch for a cursor account whose sign-in exists authenticates; a second account cannot read the first account's sign-in; and an account with no usable sign-in under confinement is reported by the smoke test and the account health as not logged in, naming the account and the login command, and is not selected for launch.
